contract.note: Frozen interface between tasks. Wave-2 tasks touch disjoint files and must not renegotiate this.
contract.MessageAuthor: apps/client/src/layers/shared/model/chat-message-types.ts — { kind: 'human'|'agent'|'system'; id: string; displayName: string; emoji?: string; color?: string; runtime?: string }
contract.MessageItemProps: gains `author: MessageAuthor` and `showAuthorHeader: boolean`; keeps every existing prop. MessageList supplies both from the row.
contract.ListRow: apps/client/src/layers/features/chat/lib/build-list-rows.ts — discriminated union on `kind`: 'message' | 'day-divider' | 'unread-divider'. Message rows carry `messageIndex` (index into the ORIGINAL messages array, load-bearing for the widget-fence and isNew rules).

tasks.title: MessageAuthor type + pure resolver
tasks.acceptance: Pure, dependency-free resolver. Every D3 branch covered: agent match, runtime fallback, human, system/local_command_output. Never returns a bare 'Assistant'.

tasks.title: ListRow model + buildListRows (replaces computeGrouping)
tasks.acceptance: O(n) single pass. Grouping breaks on author change, >5min gap (named constant), day boundary. Day dividers inserted at boundaries; unread divider at first message after the cursor. messageIndex preserved on every message row. Covers empty list, single message, cursor pointing at an absent message.

tasks.title: MessageList virtualizes rows; divider components
tasks.acceptance: Virtualizer config preserved VERBATIM (anchorTo, followOnAppend, scrollEndThreshold, measureElement zero-guard). Widget-fence and isNew rules read row.messageIndex, never the virtual row index. Dividers are real virtualized rows.

tasks.title: MessageItem gutter layout + variants
tasks.acceptance: Left avatar gutter; group start shows avatar+name+time; continuations hang-indent with neither. User bubble removed. RunWithMenu moved to a top-right hover toolbar. `presentation` mode still suppresses hover chrome and timestamps.

tasks.title: Playground, mocks, RTL tests, verification
tasks.acceptance: Playground showcases the new list with multiple authors. RTL covers group start vs continuation, both dividers, presentation mode, command output full-width. pnpm verify green.
